summary: OpenAI announced a new Premium seat tier for ChatGPT Business priced at $125/user/month (or $100 annually) offering 5x more usage and no five-hour usage cap, alongside the existing $25/month Standard seat.

mechanisms.reason: The new tier explicitly grants users significantly more usage per seat, implying higher per-user token consumption.
mechanisms.quote: Premium gives your most active teammates 5x more usage than Standard seats and removes the five-hour usage limit, so they can take on larger projects and work with fewer interruptions
